tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns who Khalid Ibne Hasan is: name, role, organization, location, links, and a short professional bio. Use this first to ground any answer about Khalid.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Returns what Khalid Ibne Hasan is currently open to (advisory, speaking, and similar engagements) plus the ways to reach him, including a direct call-booking link.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists Khalid's shipped case studies (products built at Keyin College) and his side projects (the Lab). Each entry includes a slug usable with get_case_study, a summary, and tags.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Returns the full case study for one project by slug: role, year, impact, description, highlights, and stack. Get slugs from list_projects.

tools.name: list_writing
tools.description: Lists Khalid's writing: in-site notes and Substack essays, merged and sorted newest first. Each entry has a title, source, date, and URL.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Returns the full text of one in-site note by slug. Substack essays live on Substack; for those this returns the external URL to read instead. Get slugs from list_writing.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Returns Khalid Ibne Hasan's structured resume: work experience, education, skill groups, and the URL of the downloadable PDF version.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches all of khalidibnehasan.com (case studies, side projects, writing, profile pages) for a phrase and returns matching items with URLs and snippets.

tools.name: ask_khalid
tools.description: Asks Khalid Ibne Hasan's chat persona one question and returns its answer. The persona is LLM-backed, grounded in khalidibnehasan.com content, and answers as Khalid about his work, experience, and availability. To actually reach Khalid, use the contact form at https://www.khalidibnehasan.com/contact

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_writing, get_post, get_resume, search_site · Private data: ask_khalid · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_writing, get_post, get_resume, search_site · Private data: ask_khalid · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
